title: Lawmakers Question Pakistan's 5G Rollout Amid Poor Speeds
excerpt: Members of parliament in Pakistan have criticized current internet speeds and questioned the timeline for the upcoming 5G rollout.
body_html:
Lawmakers in Pakistan have voiced strong criticism regarding the country's current internet speeds, raising concerns about connectivity issues while discussing the upcoming rollout of 5G services.

During official discussions, questions were raised about the stability and performance of existing network connections, prompting scrutiny over how the country plans to transition to newer technology while current infrastructure faces complaints.

The criticism highlights ongoing frustrations among officials regarding network quality and the management of telecommunications services across the country.
